backdate.definition: v. make effective from an earlier date
backdate.translation: vt. 写上比实际早的日期, 回溯

backdated.definition: v make effective from an earlier date
backdated.translation: v. 倒填日期( backdate的过去式和过去分词 ); 使（付款等）在较早的日期开始生效

backdates.definition: v make effective from an earlier date
backdates.translation: v. 倒填日期( backdate的第三人称单数 ); 使（付款等）在较早的日期开始生效

backdating.definition: v make effective from an earlier date
backdating.translation:
n. 倒填日期
v. 追溯（backdate的ing形式）

backdigger.translation: 反铲; 反向铲; 倒铲

backdoor.definition:
n an undocumented way to get access to a computer system or the data it contains
n an entrance at the rear of a building
n a secret or underhand means of access (to a place or a position)

backdoor file.translation: [计] 秘密文件, 非法途径文件

backdoor financing.translation: [经] 私下筹资, 后门提供资金

backdoor output.translation: [计] 秘密输出, 非法途径输出

backdoors.translation: adj. 后门的；秘密的；欺诈的；鬼鬼祟祟的，偷偷摸摸的；不正当的

backdown.definition: n. A receding or giving up; a complete surrender.
backdown.translation: n. 收回原来的声明[观点]

backdrafts.translation: n. 倒转（回程）；反向气流

backdrop.definition: n. scenery hung at back of stage

backdropped.definition:
past tense of backdrop
n. scenery hung at back of stage
backdropped.translation: (backdrop 的过去时) n. 背景幕, 背景

backdrops.definition: n. scenery hung at back of stage
backdrops.translation: n. <戏>背景幕布( backdrop的复数形式 ); 周围的景物
